findings.description: No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects stored in this bucket are not encrypted at rest by default.

findings.issue_category: no public access block / ACL restriction
findings.description: The bucket has no explicit ACL set and no aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource associated, leaving it reliant on account/bucket defaults and potentially exposed to public access.
This bucket stores sensitive ledger export data but has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, leaving data unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket, so model artifacts are stored unencrypted.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket, so operational runbook data is stored unencrypted.

findings.issue_category: insecure destroy setting on sensitive bucket
findings.description: force_destroy = true combined with no versioning allows permanent, irrecoverable deletion of all objects in the bucket, increasing risk of data loss from misuse or compromised credentials.
force_destroy = true is set without versioning enabled, meaning financial ledger export data can be permanently deleted with no recovery path, which is a data protection risk for sensitive records.
